explanation:
[EFFECT] The effect of weather on hourly demand is non-monotonic — it rises and falls across the range. Its shape is category-dependent, with the contribution highest around clear/few clouds.

[IMPORTANCE] Weather ranks 7 of 9 features by global importance (importance 0.051) — a minor driver of demand.

[RECOMMENDATION] Account for weather when planning bikes and staff: demand is highest around clear/few clouds, so allocate more there and less at the opposite end.
